final: WITH f AS (SELECT rating, length, rental_rate * 1.0 / replacement_cost AS ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99), g AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM f GROUP BY rating) SELECT AVG(avg_len) AS avg_of_avg_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio FROM g
